fusions.name: Paw on the Tail
fusions.desc: A weapon strike for 5 slashing damage that leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Toyed With
fusions.desc: A finishing thrust for 20 piercing damage that uses up every one of your afflictions on the target and adds their remaining damage to the blow. Usable only on a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Pounce Step
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 4 tiles away, and gives you 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Haunches Wound Tight
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike has 20% more critical chance. Once every 6 seconds.
